1.text: Hariho umugabo witwaga Ananiya hamwe n'umugore we Safira, agura isambu

2.text: agabanya ku biguzi byayo umugore na we abizi, maze azana igice agishyīra intumwa.

3.text: Petero aramubaza ati “Ananiya, ni iki gitumye Satani yuzuza umutima wawe kubeshya Umwuka Wera, ukīsigariza igice cy'ibiguzi by'isambu?

4.text: Ukiyifite ntiyari iyawe? Kandi umaze kuyigura, ibiguzi byayo ntibyari ibyawe ubyigengaho? Ni iki gitumye wigīra inama yo gukora utyo? Si abantu ubeshye, ahubwo Imana ni yo ubeshye.”

5.text: Ananiya abyumvise atyo aragwa umwuka urahera, ababyumvise bose bagira ubwoba bwinshi.

6.text: Nuko abasore barahaguruka baramukubira, baramujyana baramuhamba.

7.text: Hahise nk'amasaha atatu, umugore we arinjira atazi uko byagenze,

8.text: Petero aramubaza ati “Mbwira, mbese ibi biguzi ni byo mwaguze isambu?”Aramusubiza ati “Yee, ni byo.”

9.text: Petero aramubaza ati “Ni iki gitumye muhuza inama yo kugerageza Umwuka w'Umwami Imana? Dore ibirenge by'abamaze guhamba umugabo wawe bigeze ku muryango, nawe barakujyana.”

10.text: Muri ako kanya amugwa ku birenge umwuka urahera. Ba basore binjiye basanga amaze gupfa, baramujyana bamuhamba hamwe n'umugabo we.

11.text: Itorero ryose n'ababyumvise bose bagira ubwoba bwinshi.

12.text: Ibimenyetso n'ibitangaza byinshi byakorwaga mu bantu n'amaboko y'intumwa, kandi bose bateraniraga mu ibaraza rya Salomo n'umutima uhuye.

13.text: Ariko nubwo abantu bose babahimbazaga cyane, ntihagiraga n'umwe muri bo watinyukaga kwifatanya na bo.

14.text: Nyamara abizeye Umwami Yesu bakomezaga kubongerwaho, abantu benshi b'abagabo n'abagore,

15.text: byatumaga bazana abarwayi mu nzira bakabashyira ku mariri no mu ngobyi, kugira ngo Petero nahanyura nibura igicucu cye kigere kuri bamwe.

16.text: Hateraniraga benshi bavuye no mu midugudu ihereranye n'i Yerusalemu, bazanye abababazwa n'abadayimoni bose bagakizwa.

17.text: Ibyo ni byo byatumye umutambyi mukuru ahagurukana n'abari kumwe na we bose, ari bo gice kitwa icy'Abasadukayo, buzura ishyari

18.text: bafata intumwa bazishyira mu nzu y'imbohe zose.

19.text: Maze nijoro marayika w'Umwami Imana akingura inzugi z'inzu y'imbohe, arabasohora arababwira ati

20.text: “Nimugende muhagarare mu rusengero, mubwire abantu amagambo yose y'ubu bugingo.”

21.text: Babyumvise batyo, binjira mu rusengero mu museke barigisha.Bakiriyo umutambyi mukuru ajyana n'abari bafatanije na we, bahamagara abanyarukiko n'abakuru bose b'Abisirayeli, maze batuma mu nzu y'imbohe kuzana intumwa.

22.text: Ariko bagiye ntibazisanga mu nzu y'imbohe. Nuko baragaruka barababwira bati

23.text: “Inzu y'imbohe dusanze ikinze neza, n'abarinzi bahagaze inyuma y'inzugi, maze dukinguye ntitwagira umuntu dusangamo.”

24.text: Umutware w'urusengero n'abatambyi bakuru bumvise ayo magambo, bayoberwa iby'intumwa ibyo ari byo, bībaza uko bizamera.

25.text: Ariko haza umuntu arababwira ati “Dore ba bantu mwashyize mu nzu y'imbohe bahagaze mu rusengero barigisha abantu.”

26.text: Maze uwo mutware n'abasirikare baragenda babazana ku neza, kuko batinyaga rubanda ngo batabatera amabuye.

28.text: umutambyi mukuru arababaza ati “Ntitwabīhanangirije cyane kutigisha muri rya zina? None dore mwujuje i Yerusalemu ibyo mwigisha, murashaka kudushyiraho amaraso ya wa muntu!”

29.text: Petero n'izindi ntumwa barabasubiza bati “Ibikwiriye ni ukumvira Imana kuruta abantu.

30.text: Imana ya sogokuruza yazuye Yesu, uwo mwishe mumubambye ku giti.

31.text: Imana yaramuzamuye imushyira iburyo bwayo ngo abe Ukomeye n'Umukiza, aheshe Abisirayeli kwihana no kubabarirwa ibyaha.

32.text: Natwe turi abagabo bo guhamya ibyo hamwe n'Umwuka Wera, uwo Imana yahaye abayumvira.”

34.text: Ariko mu rukiko Umufarisayo witwaga Gamaliyeli, wari umwigishamategeko wubahwa n'abantu bose, arahaguruka ategeka ko baheza intumwa akanya gato.

35.text: Maze arababwira ati “Yemwe bagabo b'Abisirayeli, nimwitonde mumenye uko mugirira aba bantu.

36.text: Muzi ko mu minsi yashize Teyuda yahagurutse avuga yuko ari umuntu ukomeye, nuko abantu nka magana ane baramukurikira. Bukeye aricwa, abamwumviraga bose baratatana bahinduka ubusa.

37.text: Hanyuma ye mu minsi yo kwandikwa hāduka Umunyagalilaya witwaga Yuda, agomesha abantu benshi baramukurikira, na we aricwa n'abamwumviraga bose baratatana.

38.text: Kandi none ndababwira nti ‘Muzibukire aba bantu mubarekure, kuko iyi nama n'ibyo bakora, nibiba bivuye ku bantu bizatsindwa,

39.text: ariko nibiba bivuye ku Mana ntimuzabasha kubatsinda. Mwirinde mutazaboneka ko murwanya Imana.’ ”

40.text: Baramwumvira, nuko bahamagara intumwa barazikubita, bazibuza kwigisha mu izina rya Yesu maze barazirekura.

41.text: Ziva imbere y'abanyarukiko zinejejwe n'uko zemerewe gukorwa n'isoni bazihora iryo zina.

42.text: Nuko ntizasiba kwigisha no kuvuga ubutumwa bwiza bwa Yesu Kristo iminsi yose mu rusengero n'iwabo.
